faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.title: Quick Answers. Clear Solutions.
faq.subtitle: Looking for electrical, security, or automation solutions? Tell us about your project, and our team will respond quickly with the next steps.
faq.q1: What types of logistics services do you provide?
faq.a1: We offer comprehensive logistics solutions including freight forwarding, warehousing, distribution, supply chain management, and last-mile delivery services across the Saudi Arabia and internationally.
faq.q2: Do you handle both domestic and international shipments?
faq.a2: Yes. We manage end-to-end logistics for domestic Saudi Arabia deliveries as well as international imports, exports, and cross-border shipments with customs clearance support.
faq.q3: What is your delivery time frame for standard shipments?
faq.a3: Standard delivery times vary by destination: same-day for local Saudi Arabia, 1-2 days for GCC, and 3-7 days for international shipments. Express options are available for urgent deliveries.
faq.q4: Do you provide real-time tracking for shipments?
faq.a4: Yes. All shipments include real-time GPS tracking with SMS and email notifications at key milestones, accessible through our online portal or mobile app.
faq.q5: Can you handle temperature-controlled and fragile goods?
faq.a5: Absolutely. We have specialized cold chain logistics for perishables, pharmaceuticals, and temperature-sensitive items, plus secure handling for fragile and high-value cargo.
faq.q6: What areas do you cover for logistics services?
faq.a6: We provide logistics coverage across all UAE emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, etc.) and offer international shipping to major global destinations with partner networks.
faq.q7: Do you offer warehousing and inventory management services?
faq.a7: Yes. We provide secure warehousing facilities with inventory management, pick-and-pack services, and fulfillment solutions tailored to your business needs.
faq.q8: How do you ensure cargo safety and security?
faq.a8: All shipments are fully insured, handled by certified professionals, and tracked throughout transit. We comply with international safety standards and security protocols.
faq.q9: Can your logistics services integrate with our existing systems?
faq.a9: Yes. We offer API integration and EDI connectivity to seamlessly connect with your ERP, e-commerce platforms, and inventory management systems.
